# Cardinal

Cardinal aims at an elegant, distinct look suited to everyday use and to screenshots. It uses red accent details, subtle grid lines and expressive styled headings, with full light and dark mode support.

![Cardinal screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaysan0/cardinal/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cardinal"
    author: "jaysan0"
    repo:   "jaysan0/cardinal"
    slug:   "cardinal"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cardinal"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jaysan0/cardinal"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaysan0/cardinal/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Cardinal to give Obsidian an elegant, distinct look suited for everyday use and screenshots. Display red accent details, subtle grid lines, and expressive styled headings with full light and dark mode support."
}
```
